panels.title: Kill Switch
panels.description: kill_switch_state == 1 (instant) — active state label (RUNNING / HALTING / FLATTENING / HALTED / HALTED_DEGRADED). Instant query so historical state labels cannot appear beside the current one.

panels.title: Effective Mode
panels.description: mode_info == 1 (instant) — live effective mode label only. Instant filter so a prior effective (e.g. paper during boot before pin/startTrading) cannot appear beside the current one. See Ops Mode (id 47) for requested→effective.

panels.title: Equity
panels.description: Net-of-cost equity: equity_usdt − agentic_promotion_llm_cost_usd. Book MTM already nets quote/base fees; evidence-epoch LLM spend (PromotionReadinessService) is subtracted. Hybrid when PROMOTION_EVIDENCE_EPOCH is set (lifetime book − post-epoch LLM). Absent LLM gauge → 0 until the 5m PromotionMetrics sample. Trading Equity (id 1) stays book-only.

panels.title: Day PnL
panels.description: day_pnl_usdt — equity minus start-of-day-UTC equity. Overview health-strip Day PnL.

panels.title: Drawdown
panels.description: drawdown_ratio — (peak − equity) / peak, 0..1. RISK_MAX_DRAWDOWN_PCT halts at 0.20; thresholds mark half (0.10) and three-quarters (0.15) of the halt line for early warning.

panels.title: Decision Age
panels.description: extract(epoch from (now() - max(created_at))) from agent_decisions (Postgres RO) — journal age in seconds for the single v3 lineage. Returns a numeric field (Stat defaults exclude time-typed columns, which made the prior max(created_at)+dateTimeFromNow panel show noValue). Null max → no decisions yet.

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch from (now() - max(created_at)))::float8 AS "Age" FROM agent_decisions

panels.title: Reconcile Status
panels.description: sum by (venue, result) (increase(reconciliation_runs_total[5m])) — per-venue pass outcomes in the last 5m (clean/mismatch/halt/error), so one venue's HALT is never masked by the other's clean passes (v3 spec §8). Absent entirely outside paper/testnet mode — trading-runtime.module.ts only schedules reconcile() there.

panels.title: Venue Free Cash
panels.description: venue_free_cash_usdt{venue} — free quote/margin balance per venue wallet. Overview health strip.

panels.title: Budget Remaining
panels.description: agentic_budget_remaining_usd — ONE unified book-wide daily LLM budget. Current value; Cost row Budget Burn-Down (id 40) is the trend.

panels.title: Win Rate
panels.description: agentic_promotion_win_rate — durable fraction of closed demo round trips with per-trip net (realized − fees) > 0 over the promotion evidence window (PromotionReadinessService, sampled 5m). Same walk as Promotion Round Trips; survives restarts.

panels.title: Promotion Net PnL
panels.description: agentic_promotion_net_pnl_usd — realized PnL minus fees minus LLM spend over the earned-live promotion evidence window (PromotionReadinessService, sampled 5m). ONE lineage, ONE book (v3: no per-lane split).

panels.title: Promotion Round Trips
panels.description: agentic_promotion_round_trips — closed demo round trips toward the >=30 promotion threshold.

panels.title: Promotion Window Days
panels.description: agentic_promotion_window_days — span between the first and last closed demo round trip; must reach >=14.

panels.title: Promotion Ready
panels.description: agentic_promotion_ready — the earned-live verdict (>=30 closed demo round trips AND positive net-of-cost PnL over >=14 days). A permitted verdict still faces the unchanged four live gates and bootId-bound arming ceremony.

panels.title: Active Menu Size
panels.description: count(agentic_active_menu == 1) — symbols currently in the consulted menu. Configured AGENTIC_ACTIVE_MENU_SIZE defaults to 8 (v3 §5.2); pin + per-venue floor can push the live count above that.

panels.title: Consults (24h)
panels.description: sum(increase(agentic_consult_gate_total{outcome=~"consulted|forced_fill|forced_move|forced_fallback|forced_rearm"}[24h])) — actual LLM consults in the rolling 24h window (not calendar UTC day; not all gate evaluations).

panels.title: Open Orders (by venue)
panels.description: open_orders{venue} — v3 §8: venue-scoped fact, one series per venue (binance/binanceusdm) rather than the v2 per-process total.

panels.title: Unrealized PnL
panels.description: unrealized_pnl_usdt — Σ signedQty×(mark − avgEntry) on open positions, embedded in equity above.

panels.title: Cash
panels.description: cash_usdt — free quote (USDT) balance, book-wide.

panels.title: Peak Equity
panels.description: peak_equity_usdt — high-water mark, persisted across restarts.

panels.title: Starting Cash
panels.description: starting_cash_usdt — the seed baseline (PortfolioConfig.startingCash), the return-since-inception denominator.

panels.title: In-Flight Intents (by venue)
panels.description: in_flight_intents{venue} — v3 §8: reserved-intent count per venue.

panels.title: Venue Capital Headroom
panels.description: venue_capital_headroom_usdt{venue} — NEW (v3 §6.1): venueCap(v) − open notional − reserved notional. Zero/negative means the next entry on that venue is BELOW_MINIMUM (headroom-exhausted, not a dust order).

panels.title: Open Positions (DB truth)
panels.description: positions rows with signed_qty <> 0 (Postgres RO) — the durable ledger the reconciler defends, one row per (mode, strategy, venue, symbol). float8 casts are DISPLAY-ONLY (reference-grade); the NUMERIC(38,18) column stays exact. Empty table = flat book.

targets.rawSql: SELECT mode, venue, symbol, strategy_id AS strategy, signed_qty::float8 AS qty, avg_entry::float8 AS "avg entry", realized_pnl::float8 AS "realized pnl", updated_at AS updated FROM positions WHERE signed_qty <> 0 ORDER BY mode, venue, symbol

panels.title: Equity (one book)
panels.description: equity_usdt over the dashboard window — the ONE unified book equity curve (cash + positions marked). Overview Equity (id 103) is net-of-cost (book − evidence-epoch LLM); this panel is the book-only trend used for risk/drawdown context.

panels.title: Position Notional (by venue/strategy/symbol)
panels.description: position_notional_usdt{venue,strategy,symbol} — abs(position) × avgEntry, display-grade (v3 §8: +venue label).

panels.title: Realized PnL (by venue/strategy/symbol)
panels.description: realized_pnl_usdt{venue,strategy,symbol} — where PnL is actually coming from, now venue-labeled (v3 §8).

panels.title: Funding Payments Ingested (by venue/symbol)
panels.description: increase(funding_payments_ingested_total{venue,symbol}[1h]) — perp funding-settlement rows ingested (FundingIngestService, hourly poll).

panels.title: Reconciliation Runs (by venue/result)
panels.description: increase(reconciliation_runs_total{venue,result}[5m]) — one pass per venue per 30s tick (v3 §1.5), one series per venue×result. result="halt" pages ReconciliationHalt; result="error" pages ReconcilePassErrors.

panels.title: Protective Exits
panels.description: increase(protective_exits_total{reason}[1h]) — bot-side STOP_LOSS / TRAILING_STOP / PLAN_STOP force-exits via ProtectiveExitService (full Strategy→Risk→Execution path). Runbook Risk & safety signal. Empty until first event.

panels.title: Active Playbook Version
panels.description: agentic_playbook_info{version} — one lineage, one series now (v3 §9: the two per-lane version sequences collapse into one).

panels.title: Agent Client
panels.description: agent_client_info{kind} — 'stub' (inert, no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / test/ci) vs 'anthropic' (live, actually deciding).

panels.title: Consult Gate Outcomes
panels.description: increase(agentic_consult_gate_total{outcome}[1h]) — consulted / skipped_scheduled / forced_fill / forced_move / forced_fallback / forced_rearm (all outcomes exported — XA1). Synthetic fallback attaches (no directives while positioned) are tracked separately: increase(agentic_rearm_fallback_total[1h]).

panels.title: Reflection Outcomes
panels.description: sum by (outcome) (max_over_time(agentic_reflection_outcomes_total[6h])) — 6h high-water mark per outcome (Backlog #31). increase()/rate() miss the first sample after a container recreate; max_over_time survives redeploy-then-mint. Level in window, not an event tally — legend uses max, not sum.

panels.title: Menu Churn
panels.description: increase(agentic_menu_churn_total{direction}[1h]) — combined-basket scanner menu entering/leaving symbols per recompute.

panels.title: Playbook Validator Rejections
panels.description: increase(playbook_validator_rejections_total{banned_token,token}[6h]) — a sustained pattern means the reflection loop can never iterate (AgenticReflectionRejects alert).

panels.title: Venue TP Events (by venue/event)
panels.description: increase(agentic_venue_tp_total{venue,event}[1h]) — v3 §8: +venue. Venue-resting take-profit lifecycle for plan-mode longs. Empty until first event.

panels.title: Venue Stop Events (by venue/event)
panels.description: increase(agentic_venue_stop_total{venue,event}[1h]) — v3 §8: +venue. force_fired means a venue stop evidently failed to fill on its own — worth an operator look. Empty until first event.

panels.title: Playbook Version Attribution — Net PnL
panels.description: agentic_version_net_pnl_usd{version} — champion/candidate A/B attribution, unchanged by v3 (still feeds attributed auto-promotion).

panels.title: Playbook Version Attribution — Round Trips
panels.description: agentic_version_round_trips{version} — closed demo round trips attributed to the playbook version active at entry.

panels.title: Capability Violations (by kind)
panels.description: increase(agentic_capability_violations_total{kind}[6h]) — NEW (v3 §4.3): a decision degraded to hold for violating its symbol's capabilities (e.g. open_short on a spot symbol). Full-width: a rare-event guardrail chart — any non-zero bar is a finding (prompt/mandate defect or capability-map bug), never dismissed as noise. Empty until first event.

panels.title: Budget Burn-Down (vs $3/day breaker)
panels.description: agentic_budget_remaining_usd over the window — burn-down slope of the ONE unified daily LLM budget (resets each UTC day). A cliff-shaped drop is the R8-8 hot-loop signature (non-consuming-trigger class); compare with Decide Outcomes below. Current value lives in the Overview strip.

panels.title: LLM Tokens (by kind/model)
panels.description: increase(agent_tokens_total{kind,model}[1h]) — input/output/cache_read/cache_creation, split by model (decide vs reflection tiers).

panels.title: Decide Outcomes (by outcome/model)
panels.description: increase(agent_decide_total{outcome,model}[1h]) — proposed/hold/noop/error_retryable/error_fatal/timeout/budget_blocked.

panels.title: Decide Latency (p50)
panels.description: histogram_quantile(0.5, agent_decide_latency_seconds) — Sonnet decide-call latency.

panels.title: Promotion LLM Cost
panels.description: agentic_promotion_llm_cost_usd — DB-backed, per-model, cache-aware LLM spend over the promotion evidence window (context for Promotion Net PnL in the Trading row).

panels.title: Process RSS (WATCH-V3-1 slope)
panels.description: process_resident_memory_bytes trend — WATCH-V3-1: the 40-symbol paper plateau is ~673MiB; a sustained demo-mode climb past ~900MiB (orange line) before soak end is a defect signal, 1.2GiB (red) is the AppMemoryHigh/mem_limit ceiling. A stat cannot show slope; read current value from this series' lastNotNull.

panels.title: Event Loop Utilization
panels.description: event_loop_utilization — EventLoopUtilizationHigh alerts above 0.9 sustained 5m.

panels.title: Event Loop Delay (p99)
panels.description: event_loop_delay_p99_seconds — budget 50ms (EventLoopBudgetBreach alert); a sustained breach starves the strategy → risk → execution hot path.

panels.title: Market Stream Forced Reconnects (by venue)
panels.description: increase(market_stream_forced_reconnects_total{venue}[1h]) — v3 §8: +venue, pending workstream #5's per-venue MarketStreamsModule facade (today's aggregate labels the sole configured venue, or 'aggregate' once a second venue is live — see metrics.service.ts's own comment). MarketStreamReconnectStorm pages at >=5/hour. Empty until first event.

panels.title: Market Channel Staleness (by venue/symbol/channel)
panels.description: market_channel_staleness_seconds{venue,symbol,channel} — v3 §8: +venue. MarketChannelStale pages at >600s on ticker/candle channels.

panels.title: Derivatives Feed Staleness
panels.description: clamp_min(derivatives_feed_staleness_seconds, 0) + ((derivatives_feed_staleness_seconds < bool 0) * 900000000) — funding/OI/mark-basis context feed. Polled age when >=0; -1 (never polled) → 900000000s sentinel (distinct from real age; red above 600s). clamp_min+bool form required: Grafana range empty/`or` paths painted phantom 0.

panels.title: Sentiment Feed Staleness
panels.description: clamp_min(sentiment_feed_staleness_seconds, 0) + ((sentiment_feed_staleness_seconds < bool 0) * 900000000) — CryptoPanic headline feed. Polled age when >=0; -1 (never polled) → 900000000s sentinel (distinct from real age; red above 600s). clamp_min+bool form required: Grafana range empty/`or` paths painted phantom 0.

panels.title: Mode
panels.description: mode_info == 1 (instant) — requested→effective paper-honesty. Instant filter so historical label sets (e.g. testnet→paper during boot before effective settles) cannot appear beside the current pair — same pattern as Kill Switch (id 1).

panels.title: Reconciliation Last Success Age
panels.description: ((time() - reconciliation_last_success_timestamp_seconds) and on() (reconciliation_last_success_timestamp_seconds > 0)) or on() vector(900000000) — age since last process-wide clean reconcile. Timestamp 0 / absent → sentinel 900000000 mapped to "never succeeded" (red). Uses `or on()` so the unlabeled sentinel is suppressed whenever a real age series exists (plain `or` would show both tiles).

panels.title: Boot
panels.description: boot_info{boot_id} — the bootId-bound arming ceremony's own identifier.
